$comment: ONE-FM AG-UI extension event contract (WI-001671). Every non-text thing an agent may send. Each entry: producer(s), JSON Schema for the CustomEvent value, and one recorded example. The AG-UI protocol itself ships 26 standard event types and no UI components; everything here rides CustomEvent with a namespaced name. Cards render and request; the host surface applies.

onefm.choice.rendered_as: Option buttons under the message (panel feature, not a card)
onefm.choice.notes: Supersedes Logix DISAMBIGUATE and ProsAlly CONFIRM / CONFIRM_REMOVAL private payloads. Works without a host surface: the chosen option returns into the conversation as the next turn.

onefm.proposed_config.notes: A whole new agent configuration to create. Confirming relays the designer's approval into the conversation as the next turn; the AGENT then calls its create_agent_configuration tool. Neither the card nor the host creates anything directly.

onefm.proposed_update.notes: Recommended values for the host form. Applying writes to the form via the panel event bus — the card never mutates the form directly.

onefm.created_config.rendered_as: No card — the agent's own reply text announces it; hosts listen to link the new agent on the open shape
onefm.created_config.notes: Emitted after the assistant's create_agent_configuration TOOL ran and the reply shaper verified the record exists. The shaper reads agent_id from the record, never from the model's claim — an event is proof of a real row, not of the model saying so.

example.name: Leave Summarizer
example.summary: Created Leave Summarizer and started its creation process

onefm.script_diff.notes: Before/after script change. Apply writes to the host's script editor; the card only renders and requests. mode mirrors the Logix CREATE/MODIFY intents.

example.summary: Add a null check before reading employee.department

onefm.test_cases.notes: Supersedes the Logix tests_checklist private payload (the transcript-embedded runner LogixCanvas carried before WI-001677). Run calls run_logix_test_case via the host, which owns the linked-script name; the card only renders cases and reports pass/fail. inputs is the exact form_dict the runner replays.

example.summary: Quick checks to confirm the leave validation works

cases.when: An employee with enough remaining days asks for 5 days of leave
cases.expected: The request goes through without complaints

cases.when: An employee asks for more days than they have left
cases.expected: The script stops and explains the balance is too low

onefm.bpmn_preview.notes: One event with a mode field supersedes the BPMN_GENERATED / BPMN_MODIFIED intents and the pending_xml removal gate; the destructive-change confirm lives inside the card. Deliberate behavior change: the canvas no longer updates sight-unseen — the user reviews the preview, then applies.

example.summary: Adds Manager Approval and removes the auto-approve path

onefm.doctype_schema.notes: The whole doctype IR travels in one event; the card shows the human summary, the host's loadIr() applies it. Replaces the docu_chat_async/docu_chat_status polling loop.

onefm.table.notes: For tables the UI must understand — alignment, row actions, selection. Display-only tables need no event: agents emit a markdown table inside ordinary TextMessageContent and the panel renders it.

onefm.conversation_title.notes: Replaces Lumina's bare `event: updated_title` SSE line, which no standard AG-UI client could see.

onefm.mode_transition.notes: Adopts the existing MODE_TRANSITION CustomEvent, which was emitted with no UI consumer; renamed at the Lumina migration (WI-001678). This gives it a consumer for the first time.

onefm.lucrusher_result.rendered_as: LuCrusherResultCard — one panel per intent (matches, document, scan, topology, tasks, prompts)
onefm.lucrusher_result.notes: The existing LUCRUSHER_RESULT event, documented and renamed at the Lumina migration (WI-001678). The worker still owns the payload's inner shape; the contract pins the envelope and the `intent` that selects the panel. The worker emits its keys FLAT on the event — the relay folds them into `value` (WI-001678), so consumers only ever see the contract shape.

topology.summary: The chart mixes onboarding and access provisioning; they have different owners and SLAs.

processes.name: Employee Onboarding
processes.reason: Owned by HR end to end.

processes.name: System Access Provisioning
processes.reason: Runs on IT's SLA and can start before day one.

not_contract_events.$comment: Explicitly excluded, with reasons — so nobody re-adds them as customs.
not_contract_events.heartbeat / keep-alive: Transport plumbing. Stays an SSE comment line inside the shared generator, never an event.
not_contract_events.get_page_snapshot: A server→client tool request. Belongs on the standard AG-UI tool-call mechanism (ToolCallStart/Args/End with a client-side tool), never a custom event. NOT part of WI-001678: it was never a Lumina PAGE feature — lumina.js has no handler, the only client implementation is onefm_mcp's floating chat_widget.js, and the server side is an MCP placeholder. It ports with the embedded widget, which has a host page worth snapshotting.
